extraction.Name: Henry Black
extraction.Buyer: $5000 mortgage. but was not full settlement.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Allottee has no income nor does he receive any contributions from any source.
extraction.NOTES: Delivered at Otoe Agency; patent delivered by Noble; four minor children dependent upon allottee; allottee executed two mortgages on the land, which were foreclosed; he states that he received approximately $5000 for the land, which did not represent full value; notarized in Kay County, Oklahoma on November 2nd, 1928; commission expires Aug. 3rd, 1931
